source: White Labs Core Strain Collection poster (2023)
note: Parsed from the official White Labs 2023 Core Strain Collection poster. Poster stat column order is Attenuation, Alcohol Tolerance, Flocculation, Temp (verified against known strains). Covers the core beer + specialty collection; White Labs wine, Vault, and The Yeast Bay strains are NOT on this poster. Two kombucha cultures (WLP600-Pro, WLP600-HB) were omitted as they carry no fermentation profile. WLP800's alcohol tolerance reads 'Very High' on the poster, which looks anomalous for a pilsner strain but is preserved as printed.

yeasts.name: WLP001 California Ale Yeast
yeasts.description: The first strain produced by White Labs (1995). Versatile and hardy; accentuates hop flavors and aromas and attenuates well, even for high-gravity beers.

yeasts.name: WLP002 English Ale Yeast
yeasts.description: Classic ESB strain from one of England's largest independent breweries. Residual sweetness accentuates malt character and mild fruity esters.

yeasts.name: WLP004 Irish Ale Yeast
yeasts.description: From one of the oldest stout-producing breweries in the world. Moderate ester production; great for malty British styles such as stouts, porters, brown ales.

yeasts.name: WLP005 British Ale Yeast
yeasts.description: Known for malty English beers. Pushes bready, grainy malt flavors while being a mild ester producer.

yeasts.name: WLP007 Dry English Ale Yeast
yeasts.description: Clean profile with high attenuation, reaching 80% even in 10% ABV beers. Well-suited for high-gravity ales and clean, well-attenuated styles.

yeasts.name: WLP008 East Coast Ale Yeast
yeasts.description: Cleaner and crisper than other haze-producing strains; leaves some mouthfeel and residual sweetness that balances hop bitterness.

yeasts.name: WLP013 London Ale Yeast
yeasts.description: Oak ester character; well-suited for classic British styles. Medium flocculation allows attenuation up to 75%.

yeasts.name: WLP023 Burton Ale Yeast
yeasts.description: Sourced from Burton upon Trent, England. Subtle fruity ester profile of apple, clover honey and pear.

yeasts.name: WLP028 Edinburgh Scottish Ale Yeast
yeasts.description: Produces esters of pear and melon. Neutral at low end of its range, more estery at the higher end.

yeasts.name: WLP029 German/Kolsch Ale Yeast
yeasts.description: From a small brewpub in Cologne, Germany. Accentuates hop flavor and bitterness while creating crisp, clean, lager-like character.

yeasts.name: WLP036 Dusseldorf Alt Ale Yeast
yeasts.description: Traditional altbier-style yeast from Dusseldorf. Clean, malty German brown and amber ales; keeps hop bitterness in the background.

yeasts.name: WLP041 Pacific Ale Yeast
yeasts.description: From the Pacific Northwest. Mild ester producer; great flocculator that leaves a clear beer.

yeasts.name: WLP051 California V Ale Yeast
yeasts.description: A big ester producer showing cherry and apple. Typically leaves some residual lager-like sulfur compounds.

yeasts.name: WLP060 American Ale Yeast Blend
yeasts.description: Blend of three strains; clean and neutral with a crisp, lager-like character and accentuated hop flavors.

yeasts.name: WLP066 London Fog Ale Yeast
yeasts.description: Go-to strain for New England-style IPAs. Medium ester profile with residual sweetness and a velvety mouthfeel.

yeasts.name: WLP067 Coastal Haze Ale Yeast Blend
yeasts.description: Blend of hazy IPA strains. Hazy appearance and tropical, fruit-forward mango and pineapple esters.

yeasts.name: WLP077 Tropicale Yeast Blend
yeasts.description: Blend with high beta-lyase activity, releasing bound thiols in hops for guava, passionfruit and mango character.

yeasts.name: WLP080 Cream Ale Yeast Blend
yeasts.description: Blend of ale and lager yeast; light fruity note, clean pilsner-like flavors and slightly subdued hop bitterness.

yeasts.name: WLP090 San Diego Super Yeast
yeasts.description: Low ester producer with quick fermentations and a neutral profile. Very dry beers, high alcohol tolerance.

yeasts.name: WLP095 Burlington Ale Yeast
yeasts.description: Signature strain for a Northeast US brewery. Contributes esters and body and blends with hop flavors and aromas.

yeasts.name: WLP099 Super High Gravity Ale Yeast
yeasts.description: From England; ferments up to 25% alcohol. Produces dry beer and more esters with increasing gravity.

yeasts.name: WLP800 Pilsner Lager Yeast
yeasts.description: Classic pilsner strain from the Czech Republic. Clean, crisp, somewhat dry with a malty finish.

yeasts.name: WLP802 Czech Budejovice Lager Yeast
yeasts.description: Pilsner lager yeast from southern Czech Republic. Dry, crisp lagers with low diacetyl; up to ~80% attenuation.

yeasts.name: WLP810 San Francisco Lager Yeast
yeasts.description: Classic 'steam' yeast. Ferments across a wide 58-65F range while retaining lager-like character.

yeasts.name: WLP820 Oktoberfest/Marzen Lager Yeast
yeasts.description: Quintessential German lager strain leaving some residual sweetness and promoting malt nuance.

yeasts.name: WLP830 German Lager Yeast
yeasts.description: White Labs' most popular lager yeast and one of the most widely used lager strains in the world. Clean and crisp.

yeasts.name: WLP833 German Bock Lager Yeast
yeasts.description: From the Alps of southern Bavaria. Well balanced between malt and hop character; versatile lager yeast.

yeasts.name: WLP838 Southern German Lager Yeast
yeasts.description: Malty finish, balanced aroma and great flocculation. Strong fermenter; benefits from a diacetyl rest.

yeasts.name: WLP840 American Lager Yeast
yeasts.description: Dry, clean lagers with a light apple fruitiness. Minimal sulfur and diacetyl production.

yeasts.name: WLP850 Copenhagen Lager Yeast
yeasts.description: A Northern European lager strain emphasizing clean, crisp character and drinkability.

yeasts.name: WLP860 Munich Helles Lager Yeast
yeasts.description: Produces a malty but balanced traditional Munich-style lager. Clean, strong fermenter; Helles to Rauchbier.

yeasts.name: WLP1983 Charlie's Fist Bump Yeast
yeasts.description: Licensed from Charlie Papazian; ferments at both ale and lager temperatures for diverse styles.

yeasts.name: WLP920 Old Bavarian Lager Yeast
yeasts.description: From Southern Germany. Finishes malty with a slight ester profile.

yeasts.name: WLP925 High Pressure Lager Yeast
yeasts.description: Pressure-tolerant lager yeast; ferments lagers in ~one week at room temperature under 1.0 bar. Clean, crisp finish.

yeasts.name: WLP940 Mexican Lager Yeast
yeasts.description: From Mexico City. Clean lager beers with a crisp finish and malt/hop notes in the background.

yeasts.name: WLP300 Hefeweizen Ale Yeast
yeasts.description: Traditional German Hefeweizen strain. High isoamyl acetate (banana) balanced with phenolic clove notes.

yeasts.name: WLP320 American Hefeweizen Ale Yeast
yeasts.description: Clean beer with slight banana and clove notes; low flocculation leaves characteristic cloudiness.

yeasts.name: WLP351 Bavarian Weizen Yeast
yeasts.description: Former Yeast Lab W51. Classic German-style wheat beer with medium-to-high spicy, clove-like phenolics.

yeasts.name: WLP380 Hefeweizen IV Ale Yeast
yeasts.description: Balance of phenolics and esters; nutmeg, clove and spice dominate over banana and bubble gum.

yeasts.name: WLP400 Belgian Wit Ale Yeast
yeasts.description: Pinnacle strain for Belgian witbiers/white ales. High phenol production and herbal notes that pair with adjuncts.

yeasts.name: WLP410 Belgian Wit II Ale Yeast
yeasts.description: Fairly clean strain with medium spice-like phenol production and a residual malt character.

yeasts.name: WLP500 Monastery Ale Yeast
yeasts.description: From a Belgian monastery. Plum and cherry with a hint of bubble gum; earthier at lower temperatures.

yeasts.name: WLP510 Bastogne Belgian Ale Yeast
yeasts.description: High-gravity ale yeast producing a dry beer with a slightly acidic finish; mild on spice-like phenols.

yeasts.name: WLP530 Abbey Ale Yeast
yeasts.description: Traditional Belgian abbey strain; very high alcohol tolerance with cherry, plum and pear esters.

yeasts.name: WLP540 Abbey IV Ale Yeast
yeasts.description: Balanced fruit aroma and flavor; ideal for abbey styles including dubbels, tripels and Belgian strong ales.

yeasts.name: WLP545 Belgian Strong Ale Yeast
yeasts.description: From the Ardennes. Moderate ester and phenolic character described as dried sage and black cracked pepper.

yeasts.name: WLP550 Belgian Ale Yeast
yeasts.description: Very expressive strain with phenol-forward clove, allspice and peppercorn character.

yeasts.name: WLP565 Belgian Saison I Ale Yeast
yeasts.description: Classic saison strain from Wallonia, Belgium. Earthy, peppery and spicy.

yeasts.name: WLP566 Belgian Saison II Ale Yeast
yeasts.description: Moderate phenol producer with clove-like character; fruit-forward esters balance fruit and spice.

yeasts.name: WLP568 Belgian Style Saison Ale Yeast Blend
yeasts.description: Blend of Belgian and saison strains: pear-like esters backed by spicy, earthy, clove-like flavors.

yeasts.name: WLP570 Belgian Golden Ale Yeast
yeasts.description: From East Flanders. Combination of fruitiness and phenolic character with a clean finish.

yeasts.name: WLP575 Belgian Style Ale Yeast Blend
yeasts.description: Blend of two monastery-type strains and one Belgian ale strain; dry beers with clove and spice.

yeasts.name: WLP590 French Saison Ale Yeast
yeasts.description: Popular saison strain with pear, apple and cracked pepper; a high attenuator finishing very dry.

yeasts.name: WLP518 Opshaug Kveik Ale Yeast
yeasts.description: Temperature-tolerant kveik giving quick 3-4 day fermentations with hop-forward, clean character.

yeasts.name: WLP521 Hornindal Kveik Ale Yeast
yeasts.description: Kveik from Hornindal, Norway. Intense tropical tangerine, mango and pineapple; pairs with fruity hops.

yeasts.name: WLP618 NA All Day
yeasts.description: Non-conventional maltose-negative yeast (Saccharomycodes ludwigii) suitable for low-alcohol beer.

yeasts.name: WLP630 Berliner Weisse Blend
yeasts.description: Blend of German Weizen yeast and Lactobacillus for a subtly tart, drinkable beer.

yeasts.name: WLP644 Saccharomyces 'bruxellensis' Trois
yeasts.description: Belgian strain traditionally used for 'wild' fermentations; slightly tart with mango and pineapple.

yeasts.name: WLP645 Brettanomyces claussenii
yeasts.description: Low-intensity Brett character; fruity, pineapple-like aroma with an earthy, hay-like background.

yeasts.name: WLP648 Brettanomyces bruxellensis Trois Vrai
yeasts.description: The 'true' Brett bruxellensis Trois. Robust, complex sour character with pear aromas; highly attenuative.

yeasts.name: WLP650 Brettanomyces bruxellensis
yeasts.description: Classic secondary-fermentation strain for Belgian styles and bottle conditioning; medium, earth-forward character.

yeasts.name: WLP653 Brettanomyces lambicus
yeasts.description: High-intensity traditional Brett character: horsey, smoky and spicy.

yeasts.name: WLP655 Belgian Sour Mix 1
yeasts.description: Blend of Brettanomyces and Saccharomyces plus Lactobacillus and Pediococcus for spontaneous-style fermentations.

yeasts.name: WLP661 Pediococcus damnosus
yeasts.description: Souring bacteria producing lactic acid; a high diacetyl producer and slow growing.

yeasts.name: WLP670 American Farmhouse Yeast Blend
yeasts.description: Traditional farmhouse strain plus Brettanomyces; complex profile with a moderate level of sourness.

yeasts.name: WLP672 Lactobacillus brevis
yeasts.description: Lactobacillus for traditional or kettle souring via high lactic acid production.

yeasts.name: WLP677 Lactobacillus delbrueckii
yeasts.description: Lactic acid bacteria giving moderate acidity found in lambics, Berliner Weisse, sour browns and gueuze.

yeasts.name: WLP693 Lactobacillus plantarum
yeasts.description: Probiotic bacteria producing high levels of lactic acid; ideal for sour kettle or sour mash beers.
